topic: Google Ads AI content disclosure labels expand to California, South Korea and Vietnam (joining EU, India, New York); Google-tool assets auto-labelled, third-party AI assets declared by advertiser (Search Engine Roundtable, 5 Nov 2026)
instagram_caption:
Google's AI ad labels now cover six regions, India included.

On 5 November, Google added California, South Korea and Vietnam to the regions where its AI content labels apply. The EU, India and New York were already on the list. Ads made with Google's own generative AI tools are labelled automatically. Assets made with other AI tools rely on the advertiser to declare them. In these regions the label can show on the ad itself, and Google says using the setting alone doesn't guarantee you meet local rules.

Why it matters: AI disclosure is now a production task, not a legal footnote. If your team can't say which assets AI touched, your labels will be wrong.

What to do this week:
1. Add an "AI used?" field to every creative brief and asset tracker.
2. Ask agencies and freelancers to confirm AI use in writing, asset by asset.
3. Check the AI content label settings in Google Ads and Merchant Center for campaigns that target India.

The label is easy. Knowing the answer is the hard part.
